title: Someone else is already forwarding the repo; the watch is a conflict and catch-up reads still deliver

12.intent: Add a health check to the platform service

steps.why: Another person's forwarder holds the repo's hook: ours is told Hook already exists
Just before the 30-minute read: the read after it starts one minute before the last read's marker, so it sees this comment again
Read by the 60-minute fallback, which also reads 5001 again inside its slack: without the dedupe, 5001 rides along again
Past two fallback intervals: the read repeats, and the repeat must not deliver again
